name: LogCauchy

args.name: lmu
args.description: The location (median) of the distribution of log(X)

args.name: lscale
args.description: The scale of the distribution of log(X)

title: The log-Cauchy distribution
description: For X drawn from LogCauchy(lmu,lscale), log(X) has a Cauchy distribution with location lmu and scale lscale. Thus X > 0 and its median is exp(lmu).
